snippet.title: # 5/4! Free Online Game *Meow My Crop* Launches on Steam!
snippet.description:
🥳 What we offer: a casual idle & online crop-stealing game for FREE
💻 Available on PC and Mac
👔 Over 600 decorative items to customize your look
⌨️ Supports multiple input devices: keyboard/mouse, gamepad, drawing tablet, MIDI controller
🥕 More fun with friends: grow faster together online, and “borrow” crops from your buddies
🎵 Over 30 original music records that can be played and displayed, random drops included
🔊 Various ambient white noises to accompany your work or study!
✨ New features added: random seeds, outfit presets, status bubbles and more!

*Meow My Crop* officially goes live at **9:00 PM on May 4th**!
Add it to your Steam Wishlist and grab your friends to farm together!
We’ll be waiting for you in the crop field on 5/4~
